summary: The category includes ten electrical sheets and eight mechanical coordination sheets for the UMC Outpatient Pharmacy Remodel. Electrical work uses existing normal and emergency distribution, adds or extends pharmacy branch circuits, and specifically requires four new 20A single-pole GFCI breakers. New lighting comprises 21 L1 fixtures, one L2, 16 L3, three L4, seven variable-length L5 runs and two X1 exit signs, with occupancy sensing and dimming; compliance quantities are retained separately and must not be added to plan counts. Selective demolition includes receptacles, lighting and controls, although rectangular demolition fixture quantities and some small symbols remain unresolved. Mechanical coordination includes six new fire/smoke damper interfaces, two hydronic-reheat terminal boxes, five thermostat relocations and two new sensor locations; E2.01 explicitly shows a new VAV connection only for VV-2-N. Fire alarm revisions are design-build, communications cabling and devices are by others, and mechanical/controls responsibilities require coordination with electrical control-power requirements. Hospital operations must remain active, with coordinated outages, temporary services, essential-power commissioning and an updated coordination study. Important clarifications include demolition circuit reuse, above-ceiling raceways and MC restrictions, healthcare space boundaries, emergency lighting circuiting, existing panel data, and trade responsibilities for controls and restoration. No dependable installed electrical run lengths or new feeder routes are established by these sheets.
